definitions.gloss: serial drama; TV series; ongoing television drama
definitions.explanation: A television drama that airs weekly over a set number of episodes, typically one season (one cour) of 10-12 episodes in Japan. Distinguished from single-episode specials or movies.

examples.japanese: {今期|こんき}の{連続|れんぞく}ドラマは{面白|おもしろ}い。
examples.english: This season's TV series are interesting.

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{月曜|げつよう}の{連続|れんぞく}ドラマを{楽|たの}しみにしている。
examples.english: I look forward to the weekly Monday drama series.

examples.japanese: あの{俳優|はいゆう}は{連続|れんぞく}ドラマに{初|はじ}めて{主演|しゅえん}することになった。
examples.english: That actor has been cast as the lead in a serial drama for the first time.

notes:
A television drama format that runs weekly across multiple episodes, forming the backbone of Japanese prime-time programming. In Japan, dramas typically follow a seasonal pattern (winter, spring, summer, fall) with each season lasting about three months (one cour).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連続|れんぞく}ドラマに{出演|しゅつえん}する: to appear in a serial drama
- {連続|れんぞく}ドラマの{最終回|さいしゅうかい}: the final episode of a serial drama
- {連続|れんぞく}ドラマの{視聴率|しちょうりつ}: viewership ratings of a serial drama
- {月|げつ}9ドラマ: Monday 9 PM drama (famous Fuji TV time slot)

FORMS:
Commonly shortened to 連ドラ (れんドラ) in casual speech. This abbreviation is widely used in everyday conversation, entertainment news, and social media.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {単発|たんぱつ}ドラマ: one-off/special drama — a standalone drama broadcast as a single episode
- {朝|あさ}ドラ: morning drama — NHK's serialized 15-minute morning drama (formally {連続|れんぞく}テレビ{小説|しょうせつ})
- {大河|たいが}ドラマ: historical drama — NHK's year-long Sunday drama series
